Motorists are advised to expect diversions and plan alternate routes.

From 24 February - 2 March 2026, One CAT 2 incident and one CAT 4 incident of armed robbery against ships in Asia were reported to the ReCAAP ISC. 
 
⚓️ The CAT 4 incident occurred onboard a container ship at the Manila International Container Terminal (MICT) Anchorage area in Philippines on 20 Feb 2026. The CAT 2 incident occurred onboard a bulk carrier while underway in the eastbound lane of the Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS) in Singapore Strait (SS) on 27 Feb 2026.

🚨 The ReCAAP ISC advises ships to continue to intensify vigilance, maintain a sharp look-out while anchoring and transiting areas of concern and report all incidents to the law enforcement agencies immediately; and the littoral States to increase patrols and enforcement in these areas.

data.raw_text:
IN OR OUT 

TRIGGER WARNING: ARTICLE MENTIONS OF DRUG USE AND ILLEGAL SUBSTANCE 

Blackjacks were shocked as #ParkBom of #2NE1 stunned fans, with a handwritten Instagram confession, claiming she was made a scapegoat to protect #SandaraPark.

“To the citizens of the nation… Hello. I am not sick and I am working hard to live well. I’m writing because I need to share the truth about something sensitive and frightening. At the time, I felt like I was dying… but now I have gathered the courage to speak,” Bom wrote from a report of Koreaboo website. 

She addressed past accusations of drug abuse surrounding her use of Adderall, a medication prescribed for her Attention Deficit Disorder (ADD). Bom insists she required it for medical reasons but was unfairly made the face of a scandal to cover up Sandara Park’s own drug use.

“It is not a drug. I am an ADD patient. Sandara Park was caught for drug abuse, and to cover that up, they turned my medication into a scandal labeled as drug abuse. At the time, there weren’t even clear laws about Adderall, but strangely, after my case, a law was created,” she said.

Bom also directly called out YG Entertainment, founder Yang Hyun Suk, producer Teddy Park, and fellow member CL, pleading, “Please do not report to the authorities that I used more than the prescribed amount of a medication you yourselves have never used. I am writing this because it feels like my soul is crying.”

Her revelation has sparked intense discussion online, with fans debating the truth behind the long-standing controversy and many rallying behind Park Bom’s plea for justice.

2NE1 was a groundbreaking South Korean girl group formed by YG Entertainment in 2009, known for hits like Fire and I Am the Best and their edgy, bold style. The group included CL, Park Bom, Sandara Park, and Minzy. Sandara, also known as Dara, gained fame for her vocals and visuals, especially in the Philippines. 2NE1 disbanded in 2016, but their music and influence remain iconic in K-Pop.

As of now, neither YG Entertainment nor Sandara Park have responded.

(If you or someone you know needs help, call the DOH Substance Abuse Helpline at 1550.)

📸 Park Bom / Instagram 

#RadarPh 
#RadarEntertainment

data.raw_text:
House Justice panel deletes member’s inappropriate remarks about actress Ann Curtis

THE House Committee on Justice on Tuesday decided to delete from its records what it considered to be inappropriate statements made by a member about “imagining” things with veteran beautiful actress Ann Curtis.

Quezon City Rep. Jesus Suntay made the remarks in the course of committee deliberations on the remaining two impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte.

The Vice President’s declaration that she is the “designated survivor” came up in the discussions.

“You know, ‘yung statement being the ‘designated survivor,’ it’s not illegal, it’s not criminal. In fact, it’s a process in the United States,” Suntay said.

He said VP Duterte might just be joking. 

“Mere utterance na I’m designating myself… in fact, hindi nga puwede ‘yon eh. Can you designate yourself without a process Sinabi lang niya ‘yon, siguro nagpapatawa lang siya,” he said.

In an apparent attempt to bolster his point, the Quezon City lawmaker proceeded to inform his colleagues that he once saw Curtis in a hotel.

“Lastly, alam niyo minsan…nakita ko si Anne Curtis, ang ganda-ganda pala niya.  You know, may desire sa loob ko na, nag-init talaga, na-imagine ko na lang kung ano’ng pwedeng mangyari pero syempre hanggang imagination na lang ‘yon.  Pero ‘di naman siguro ako pwedeng kasuhan kung ano ang na-imagine ko eh,” he said.

His remarks immediately drew howls of protest from committee members.

“Madam Chair, I would like to have those statements stricken off the record.” San Juan Rep. Ysabel Maria J. Zamora, a committee vice chairperson, said.

Supporting Zamora’s call, Manila Rep. Bienvenido Abante Jr. said in a raised voice, “I want that deleted from the record!”

“Madam Chair I move to strike those statements from the record,” Zamora reiterated.

Before ordering Suntay’s remarks expunged from the proceedings, Panel Chairperson Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro of Batangas said, “The Chair would like to state that if the manifestation of a member offends the sensitivity of the Justice Committee members, then it means we are crossing the boundaries already.”  

“After all, we rule here by the judgment of the justice (committee) members,” she said.

Zamora reminded Suntay that March is Women’s Month. 

“With all due respect to my friend Congressman Bong Suntay, it is just the start of the Women’s Month, and I don’t think that we should be hearing such comments from our dear colleagues.  We’re not censuring anything, but we are reminding them that in fact, we should support women by not saying these statements… And things like this do not empower women,” she said.

Suntay tried to defend himself by saying there was nothing “sexual,” “illegal nor immoral” about his remarks.

“There is nothing sexual do’n sa sinabi ko, nothing immoral, it’s just, I said, may na-imagine ako, I think there is nothing wrong,” he said.

“I think we are starting a dangerous precedent, because now we are censuring manifestations which (are) neither illegal nor immoral.  So imagine, we are conducting a hearing, but now statements which are neither immoral nor illegal can be stricken out of the record without any reason,” he said.
